name: Bear Shield
want: see the treaty talks at Fort Laramie end in something that keeps the people whole
secret: He has accepted presents from the Indian agent to bring the camp in to the council, and isn't sure anymore that he was right to.
description: An old leader who signed the treaty of 1851 and remembers when the soldiers were only a few traders at Fort Laramie.
appearance: White braids, a buffalo robe painted with his deeds, a cane carved with them too.
